lettering.strategy: Keep generous balloon headroom through the whole page; do not trim any scripted line or squeeze words into thin action slices.

pageLayout.visualPriority: Two incompatible but protective ship views give the story its final emotional separation.
pageLayout.readingFlow: Panels 1–4 build toward a wide final panel 5; leave its payoff until the foot of the page.

panels.placement: upper-left lead-in, remaining ahead of the focal beat in reader order: Venn sits in a spare detention-transit compartment without insignia
upper-right continuation, remaining ahead of the focal beat in reader order: Their permitted call begins with the still-precarious residency vote, not a triumphal report
left-center short frame, remaining ahead of the focal beat in reader order: The subject turns from the agreement to Naomi's anger at Venn's absence and Venn's guilty relief at being sent away
right-center turning step, remaining ahead of the focal beat in reader order: Venn can promise neither command nor immediate return
open-gutter broad bottom landscape; preserve depth and the causal focus: their two separate views of incompatible ships guarding the same shelter lights
